cards.a: Entebbe Vibe - Entebbe - Vibe
cards.note: The city of Entebbe, southwest of Kampala, can often be recognized by feeling slightly emptier than most of the capital, with more greenery and somewhat fancier houses. The area also has significantly more street signs than the rest of the capital.

cards.a: Kamapla Unique Car - Kampala - Unique Car
cards.note:
This Unique Car is used everywhere throughout Kampala. It can be easily recognized by it's distinct boxy shape and squared side mirrors.

NOTE: This car can also sometimes be seen in National Parks as well as a similar one on the Island of San Andrés (east of Nicaragua), however that car has rounded mirrors.

cards.a: Kampala City Centre - Kampala - City Centre
cards.note: In the city centre of Kampala, you will see paved roads with black-and-white curbs. In contrast to the rest of the city, the city centre looks richer and very built-up, with lots of multi-storey buildings.

cards.a: Kampala Landscape - Kampala - Landscape
cards.note: Kampala is a very hilly city, and as such it is rare to get a round without elevation or noticeable hills.

cards.a: Kampala Red Soil - Kamapala - Red Soil
cards.note: Like most of the national park coverage, Kampalan soil is typically very red. Even paved roads normally have a noticeable red, purple or pink tinge.

cards.a: Kampala Taxi Buses - Kamapala - Taxi Buses
cards.note: Throughout Kampala, you will often see these taxi buses, with a blue blocky pattern on the sides. These are a good clue for the city if you are not able to see the Google car.

cards.a: Kibale Dark Tiny Forest Paths - Kibale - Dark Tiny Forest Paths
cards.note: The central coverage of Kibale consists of somewhat to very dark and tiny forest paths. Similar paths can be found in Semuliki, however those will be wetter and more humid.

cards.a: Kibale Normal Forest Roads - Kibale - Normal Forest Roads
cards.note: In the two long eastern parts of coverage in Kibale you will find yourself on forest roads that are wide enough for a car. They are also normally brighter than the central coverage and sometimes lead outside the forest.

cards.a: Kibale Primate Lodge - Kibale - Primate Lodge
cards.note: This easily recognizeable Lodge is located in the centre of Kibale.

cards.a: Kibale Tourist Information - Kibale - Tourist Information
cards.note: This building for tourist information can be found near the centre of Kibale. You can see it from three different viewing angles so remember its green color and shape.

cards.a: Kibale Wide Dirt Road - Kibale - Wide Dirt Road
cards.note: The coverage of the very western part of Kibale is on a very wide dirt road. This road is unique to Kibale with only few other places that may look similar.

cards.a: Kidepo Amopuas Rock - Kidepo - Amopuas Rock
cards.note: This unique Rock can be found in the western part of Kidepo.

cards.a: Kidepo Apoka Safari Lodge - Kidepo - Apoka Safari Lodge
cards.note: This Lodge can be found in the northern part of the main coverage.

cards.a: Kidepo Hostel Bandas - Kidepo - Hostel Bandas
cards.note: These round hostels are located in the northern part of the main coverage. They can be seen from multiple angles but are sometimes hard to spot so if you're in Kidepo keep an eye out for them.

cards.a: Kidepo Kakine Campsite - Kidepo - Kakine Campsite
cards.note: This campsite, in the centre of the Kidepo coverage, can be easily recognized by its two circular shelters.

cards.a: Kidepo Katurum Lodge - Kidepo - Katurum Lodge
cards.note: This unique Lodge, surrounded by mountains and lots of vegetation, is found in the southern part of Kidepo.

cards.a: Kidepo Mountains and Grass - Kidepo - Mountains and Grass
cards.note: The Kidepo National Park is very recognizeable by mountain ranges being found in almost all directions. Furthermore, the grass is usually of medium length and green-golden-ish, however this might vary.

cards.a: Kidepo Nagusokopire Campsite - Kidepo - Nagusokopire Campsite
cards.note: Similar to the Kakine Campsite, this one also features two circular shelters, however one of them is surrounded by many trees, making them easy to tell apart. It is located in the northern part of the main coverage.

cards.a: Kidepo North Forested Roads - Kidepo - North Forested Roads
cards.note: The southern half of the north road in Kidepo is somewhat forested, and as such it may occasionally be hard to see the various mountains.

cards.a: Kidepo North Wide Mountain - Kidepo - North Wide Mountain
cards.note: The northern half of the north road in Kidepo is located in a savannah and can be easily recognised by the wide mountain to the north.

cards.a: Lake Mburo Black Soil - Lake Mburo - Black Soil
cards.note: In a large part of Lake Mburo you can find very distinct dark and even black soil on the side of the road. You will generally only see it on the marked roads, however there are a few rare exceptions.

cards.a: Lake Mburo Deciduous Forest - Lake Mburo - Deciduous Forest
cards.note: In this small part of Lake Mburo you'll be able to find yourself in a small deciduous forest. Sometimes you can also see a man in a red shirt nearby.

cards.a: Lake Mburo Eagle's Nest Hotel - Lake Mburo - Eagle's Nest Hotel
cards.note: The Eagle's Nest Hotel can be easily remembered by being on top of a mountain. It can sometimes be seen from a farther away but is quite hard to spot.

cards.a: Lake Mburo Lakeside - Lake Mburo - Lakeside
cards.note: You can only see the actual Lake Mburo from the road east of it, except for one other location.

cards.a: Lake Mburo Tiny Village - Lake Mburo - Tiny Village
cards.note: This tiny village is the only location not east of the Lake Mburo you can see the lakeside from, making it easy to recognize.

cards.a: Lake Mburo Vibes - Lake Mburo - Vibes
cards.note: Lake Mburo National Park, located west of lake Victoria, has by far the driest coverage in the country. The grass is almost always completely dried out, which is normally enough to recognise it. Bushes and trees along the road also typically look very dry. The area is quite hilly, but not mountainous.

cards.a: Mount Elgon Camp - Mount Elgon - Camp
cards.note: This camp featuring two wooden benches and huts with green steel roofs is found at the western end of the eastern path.

cards.a: Mount Elgon Church - Mount Elgon - Church
cards.note: This Church made of orange bricks can be found in the very west of the Mount Elgon coverage.

cards.a: Mount Elgon Follow Men - Mount Elgon - Follow Men
cards.note:
On the western road of Mount Elgon you should almost always be able to see one to three men following you. Furthermore, there are two different pairs of men, one in the east and one in the west. They will be in the direction of where you should guess. (Men in the west => guess in the west)

NOTE: There are very few locations without someone or different men following you which are not covered in this map!

cards.a: Mount Elgon Top - Mount Elgon - Top
cards.note: Everywhere on top of Mount Elgon you'll be out in the open with distinct small palm-like trees. Moreover, you'll also almost always be followed by an armed man in green clothes.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Airport - Murchison Falls - Airport
cards.note: This airport, easily recognized by the metal fence, is located in the western part of Murchison Falls.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Dirt Barrier - Murchison Falls - Dirt Barrier
cards.note: These dirt barriers are most commonly found in Murchison Falls National Park, however be careful as they can also be seen in other parks such as the Queen Elizabeth National Park, so use other metas to confirm your guess.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Ferry - Murchison Falls - Ferry
cards.note: This ferry, located in the centre of Muchison Falls, can be recognized by either the globe found on both riversides or by being on a platform on top of the river.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Gas Station - Murchison Falls - Gas Station
cards.note: This gas station can be found in the centre of Murchison Falls.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Grass Lines - Murchison Falls - Grass Lines
cards.note: Another, however less accurate, way to recognize Murchison Falls are grass lines running through the road, especially whenever you can't see any dirt barriers. Be careful when using this meta though since they can be found in most other parks as well.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Lodge Ruin - Murchison Falls - Lodge Ruin
cards.note: These ruins are located in the northern part of Murchison Falls.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Palms - Murchison Falls - Palms
cards.note: Seeing these palms in Uganda means you are extremely likely to be in the northern parts of Murchison Falls.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Paraa Primary School - Murchison Falls - Paraa Primary School
cards.note: This School is found in the centre of Murchison Falls.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Paraa Safari Lodge - Murchison Falls - Paraa Safari Lodge
cards.note: This Lodge is found in the centre of Murchison Falls. You might sometimes be able to recognize its entrance from farther away by the yellow curbs.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Sambiya River Lodge - Murchison Falls - Sambiya River Lodge
cards.note: The entrance to the Sambiya River Lodge is located in the more southern part of the main Murchison Falls coverage.

cards.a: Murchison Falls Student Centre - Murchison Falls - Student Centre
cards.note: This white building is located in the centre of Murchison Falls.

cards.a: Murchison Falls White Nile - Murchison Falls - White Nile
cards.note: In the western part of Murchison Falls you are often able to see the White Nile or one of its headstreams, the Victoria Nile, which is a lot smaller though.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Entale Safari Camp - Queen Elizabeth - Entale Safari Camp
cards.note: This camp features a tall, red and white metal tower which can sometimes be seen from a bit farther away.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Gas Station - Queen Elizabeth - Gas Station
cards.note: This gas station can be found on the very south western tip of the Queen Elizabeth coverage.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Grey/Brown Soil - Queen Elizabeth - Grey/Brown Soil
cards.note: Queen Elizabeth National Park is one of the only places in Uganda where you will commonly see dirt which is not red. Instead, the dirt will typically be either brown or grey(ish).

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Katwe Village - Queen Elizabeth - Katwe Village
cards.note:
Katwe Village is the only large settlement besides Kampala and Entebbe. It can feature both the normal Uganda car and the national park car. If you see the Uganda car, to not mistake it with another city, look out for cacti or a large vehicle with a cage, as you're alaways able to see either one.

NOTE: The vehicle might be very far away and difficult to spot, so don't rule out Katwe if you don't spot it right away.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Kazinga Channel - Queen Elizabeth - Kazinga Channel
cards.note: If you think you're in Queen Elizabeth National Park and see a large body of water and can see the other coast nearby you should be on a road near the Kazinga Channel.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Lake Bunyampaka - Queen Elizabeth - Lake Bunyampaka
cards.note: This lake with two buildings is the only water crater that's in the very east.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Lake Edward - Queen Elizabeth - Lake Edward
cards.note: If you think you're in Queen Elizabeth National Park and see a large body of water, with the other lakeside being quite far away, you're likely along the coast of Lake Edward.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Large Cacti - Queen Elizabeth - Large Cacti
cards.note:
These large cacti can be seen almost everywhere throughout Queen Elizabeth.

NOTE: Occasionally similar cacti can be seen in other national parks.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Paved Road - Queen Elizabeth - Paved Road
cards.note: This paved road is the only one outside Kampala and therefore unique to Queen Elizabeth National Park. There is also a power line running parallel to the road which can be spotted from farther away.

cards.a: Queen Elizabeth Water Craters - Queen Elizabeth - Water Craters
cards.note: These large craters filled with water can be found in the north western part of Queen Elizabeth. You might not always be able to see the water, however the landscape and vegetation is easy to remember. Also, unlike other parts of this National Park you will almost never find cacti near the craters.

cards.a: Semuliki Bright Paths - Semuliki - Bright Paths
cards.note: Bright forest paths, often exposed to the outside, are found on the northern half of the western coverage in Semuliki.

cards.a: Semuliki Female Hot Spring - Semuliki - Female Hot Spring
cards.note: The female hot spring can be recognized by only having a sign and no shelters.

cards.a: Semuliki Male Hot Spring - Semuliki - Male Hot Spring
cards.note: The male hot spring can be recognized by also featuring a sign but additionally also two shelters.

cards.a: Semuliki Muddy Forest Paths - Semuliki - Muddy Forest Paths
cards.note: The southern coverage of both paths in Semuliki are usually very muddy forest paths. This is important in order to tell them apart from the ones found in Kibale which are normally dryer and covered in lots of leaves.

cards.a: Semuliki South Mountains - Semuliki - South Mountains
cards.note: In a southern part of the eastern path of Semuliki you can see the distinct southern mountains. They can also be seen a bit more north but that part has very tall grass.

cards.a: Semuliki Tall Grass - Semuliki - Tall Grass
cards.note: In the south of the eastern path in Semuliki there is a part outside of the forest with very tall grass. You will also almost always be able to see mountains.

cards.a: Semuliki Water Drops - Semuliki - Water Drops
cards.note: On most of the coverage in Semuliki you can find water drops on the camera lense. This is especially found in the north of the eastern path and middle of the western one.
